portableRemainder: Controller independent empirical acceptance of the published original unit.

nativeRemainder.blocker: Native worker/placement, live journey load, exclusive lease and operator fault authorization are unavailable and not approved; all current fault/topology/recovery evidence is authored teaching data.
requiredEvidence: Terminate only one explicitly owned application worker under an approved bounded live workload.
Observe actual surviving capacity, latency, session/cart/receipt or declared application state and user outcomes.
Distinguish process/application-worker loss from node, zone and region failures using actual scope evidence.
Record owned recovery and cleanup; do not infer zone/region outage tolerance from worker survival.
nativeRemainder.sourceAcceptanceUnfulfilled: Surviving capacity and state meet the declared contract; worker/process versus node/region failure is accurately labeled.
